hero.name: Tiago Alcântara
hero.intro: I'm part of the team that maintains and improves a payment authorizer handling more than 1 million transactions a day. I work on production support and continuous improvement alongside the client, and I own the observability side: the metrics, dashboards and alerts that show what the system is doing.

about.label: about
about.title: About
about.lead: I'm a software engineer at THCS in São Paulo. One idea ties my work together: make systems possible and visible.
about.metaDescription: Who Tiago Alcântara is, how he works, what his role is today and his education.
about.whoTitle: Legible to whoever has to decide
about.who1: I take something nobody can quite see and make it legible to the people who have to decide. Sometimes it is the behavior of a system in production, sometimes a procedure that only lived in someone's head, sometimes a quality criterion that had never been written down.
about.who2: My interests sit across four tracks: software engineering, DevOps and cloud architecture, data engineering and AI engineering. I don't see that as scattered. Readable software, observable infrastructure, data that turns into decisions and AI whose behavior you can follow are the same problem seen from four sides.
about.methodTitle: Three steps, always in this order
about.method1Body: I organize the content and build a prototype before building the real thing. Being wrong in a draft is cheaper.
about.method2Body: The people who will use it decide whether it works. A dashboard is only good if the client reads it unaided.
about.method3Body: What comes back from real use is worth more than my first idea.
about.roleIntro: I work on systems that serve large Brazilian financial institutions. My day splits into four fronts.
about.role1Body: Internal tools and REST API integrations, with authentication flows, in TypeScript, Java with Spring Boot and Vue.
about.role2Body: From code to dashboard: metrics instrumented in the application, PromQL queries, Alertmanager alerts and Grafana dashboards.
about.role3Body: I follow the live system alongside clients and automate what repeats, like the scripts that bring services back after a server restarts.
about.role4Body: I plan and run production changes with the client, with the procedure written before the window opens.
